Context: 5. Relaxations.-

Fixation of the pay of the pre-revised pay scale of 1S scale granted to candidates appointed as trainees on compassionate grounds in the Seventh Central Pay Commission with effect from 1-1-2016.Level-1 of the Pay Matrix introduced on implementation of the Seventh CPC Report will be the replacement for the pre-revised -1 S scale. The pay of the trainees governed by the 1 S scale· may be revised by using the Fitment Factor of 2.57 for placement in Level-1 in conformity with the Rule 7 of the CCS (RP) Rules,
